title: Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies (In a Pan)
creator: What Erin Cooks (Erin Roberts)
cookTime: 30-34 minutes at 375 degrees F per the video (her Substack says start checking at 15 minutes)
ingredients: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, room temperature
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line a 13x9 pan with parchment.
Step 2: Cream the butter, brown sugar and sugar with a handheld or stand mixer (paddle). Add the vanilla and mix. Add the eggs and mix until combined.
Step 3: Add the flour, cornstarch, baking soda and salt; mix until a dough forms. Add the chocolate chips and mix or stir.
Step 4: Dump the dough into the pan.
Step 5: Bake 30-34 minutes or until the top and edges are golden brown.
notes: From a What Erin Cooks (Erin Roberts) Facebook reel; the pan version is written out in the caption. One bowl, no chilling. Full recipe page: https://whaterincooks.substack.com/p/famous-chocolate-chip-cookies. Bake time is unclear: her Substack says for the pan she starts checking at 15 minutes and every couple of minutes until the edges brown, which differs from the video's 30-34 minutes. Substack individual-cookie version: chill dough 2-24 hours, roll into balls, bake 9-11 minutes (serves 24). Not stated: servings for the pan version and prep time.
